_doc: NPC skaters (command `npc spawn [n]`; src/sim/game/npc.ts, docs/mechanics/npc.md): per world, how many and which rider lines they ride. Each is born with a style (styles, picked by share) and a skill drawn from the style's range. speed: cruising speed (m/s, x the style's speed, +- speedJitter). A trick try every style.trickEvery seconds on a straight at speed: crouch chargeTicks, pop, then a flip (flipChance), a grab held grabTicks (grabChance), a grind try (grindChance, more likely when a rail or ledge is right ahead) or a plain ollie. A trick that starts a combo gets style.links more links: landing with the combo open, a manual (manualChance, held manualTicks) popped out into a flip, grab or grind; off a grind, a flip out (flipOut). A sloppy try (chance (1 - skill) x sloppy) flips lateTicks late or lets go of the balance for lapseTicks. Grinds are held grindTicks, then ollied off. sends: lines whose end a style with send > 0 goes for (gap: an ollie off the end over the set, wall: on up the wall), ridden as the line's first keep points (all of them when keep is left out; 0: the run starts at the first via point, off the line), then the via points [x, y] (past the set; head-on up the Otis quarter at the Hellride spine), at speed m/s. spots: lines that share a spot; one rider at a time per spot (a line not listed is its own spot): the next waits at the top (a step back or beside the start, waitGap metres from any other waiter; at most maxWait seconds, then picks another line); a respawn picks a free spot freeSpot of the time, and a run on a spot ends at its line's end. near: a line starting within radius metres of you is picked share of the time, when some lines do and some do not (a city's lines spread over it). cheer: an NPC within range metres of you when you land a combo of points or more stomps its board (npcCheer; once per cooldown seconds). copy: after such a combo of copy.points, chance that the nearest riding NPC within range rides your last copy.seconds of line after you, popping where you popped (npcCopy); your line is kept a point every trail.every ticks for trail.seconds. At a line's end they ride on to a line starting within linkRange m, else respawn; also after a bail, when stuck stuckTicks, or more than lostRange m from the line. castFrom: the height they look down from for the ground at a line start (under the freeway).
